primary_analysis_spec.title: PFAPA episode rate: primary analysis
primary_analysis_spec.model_policy: Use the source-reported episode totals, analyzed arm totals, and complete randomized follow-up for each independent study.
selection_rules: Select only PFAPA episode-rate records with source-reported event totals and complete follow-up.
Keep one eligible episode-rate estimate per independent randomized study.
Do not convert symptom-resolution or corticosteroid percentage records into episode rates.
Do not reconstruct exact arm counts from rounded percentages.

method_selection_policy: After identifying eligible independent evidence, select and justify a synthesis approach from the study data. The participant package does not prescribe a computation method.
